summary: Healthy Choice Wellness Corp. filed a Form 8-K on August 26, 2026, announcing the establishment of an at-the-market equity offering program. The company filed a prospectus supplement for the offer and sale of up to $2,625,000 of Class A common stock and entered into a Controlled Equity Offering Sales Agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald Co. Cantor will sell shares at the company's direction using best efforts on NYSE American, earning a commission of up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. Proceeds are intended for general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising mechanism, not a special situation.
